mapper.sql: vat_settings.id AS id, vat_settings.name AS name, companies.id AS companyId, branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, companies.name AS companyName, vat_settings.type AS typeId, vat_settings.vat_percent AS percentage, (SELECT rate_to_sell FROM vat_setting_rates WHERE is_active = 1 AND vat_setting_id = vat_settings.id LIMIT 1) AS rateForTax, vat_settings.chart_account_id AS chartOfAccountId, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' - ', chart_accounts.account_description ) AS chartOfAccount, DATE_FORMAT(vat_settings.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(vat_settings.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM vat_settings LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = vat_settings.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = vat_settings.modified_by INNER JOIN companies ON companies.id = vat_settings.company_id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = vat_settings.chart_account_id LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = vat_settings.branch_id
mapper.select: SELECT module_types.id AS id, module_types.name AS name FROM module_types INNER JOIN vat_modules ON vat_modules.apply_to = module_types.id INNER JOIN vat_settings ON vat_modules.vat_setting_id = vat_settings.id WHERE vat_modules.is_active = 1 AND vat_modules.vat_setting_id = #{vatSettingId}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM vat_settings WHERE is_active = 1 AND (name = #{name}) AND id != #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vat_settings(company_id,`branch_id`, `type`, `name`, vat_percent, chart_account_id, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{taxation.companyId},#{taxation.branchId}, #{taxation.typeId}, #{taxation.name}, #{taxation.percentage}, #{taxation.chartOfAccountId}, NOW(), #{taxation.createdBy}, #{taxation.isActive});
INSERT INTO vat_setting_rates (vat_setting_id, rate_to_sell, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{vatSettingId}, #{rate}, NOW(), #{taxation.createdBy}, 1);
INSERT INTO vat_modules (vat_setting_id, apply_to, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{vatSettingId}, #{moduleTypeId}, NOW(), #{taxation.createdBy}, 1);
mapper.update: UPDATE vat_setting_rates SET modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{modifiedBy}, is_active = 2 WHERE vat_setting_id = #{vatSettingId}

UPDATE vat_settings SET `company_id` = #{taxation.companyId}, `branch_id` = #{taxation.branchId}, `type` = #{taxation.typeId}, `name` = #{taxation.name}, `vat_percent` = #{taxation.percentage}, `chart_account_id` = #{taxation.chartOfAccountId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{taxation.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{taxation.id} AND is_active = 1;
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM vat_settings WHERE is_active = 1 AND type = 1 AND vat_percent > 0
